In this notebook, I will create plots for supplemental figure 3

# Setup

```{r setup}
library(scales)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggbreak)

thisseed <- 231103

colFGID <- "#1E88E5"
coliCD <- "#55D276"
colcCD <- "#FFC107"
colUC <- "#D81B60"

diagSub.comp <- list(c("FGID", "cCD"), c("iCD", "cCD"), c("cCD", "UC"), c("FGID", "UC"))
diagSubColVec <- c("FGID"=colFGID, "iCD" = coliCD, "cCD"=colcCD, "UC"=colUC)

colCelltypes <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 7, "Set1")[c(1:5,7)]
celltypes <- c("ColEpi", "Stroma", "Myeloid", "Plasma", "BCell", "TNKILC")
names(colCelltypes) <- celltypes

source("../functions/ComparisonPlottingFxns.R")
```

```{r}
obs <- readRDS("out/annotations/scvi/251017__predictCOL_CB_allcells_obs.rds")
obs
```

# Cell Frequency

## ColEpi

```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=4}
PlotBoxplotsProp(
  obs %>% filter(timepoint == "T0") %>% droplevels,
  ann.col = "cellstate",
  filterCol = "cellstate",
  filterVal = c("Colonocyte", "Inflm. Col.", "Goblet", "Inflm. Gob.", "CCL24+ Gob.", "LGR5+ Epi.", "SAA+ Epi."),
  relative.to = "celltype",
  minDenomFreq = 10,
  exportDF = T
) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = diagSub, y = prop)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = NA) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = diagSub), size = 4,
             shape = 21, alpha = 0.75, position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.75, seed = thisseed)) +
  facet_grid(~cellstate) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 7)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  scale_color_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = diagSub.comp, label = "p.format", vjust = 1.4, size = 4.5) + 
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent, breaks = seq(0,1,0.20)) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(
    x = NULL, 
    y = "Percentage of ColEpi Cells", 
  ) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", angle = 0, hjust=0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = colCelltypes["ColEpi"], linewidth = 3),
  )
```

```{r, fig.width=2.75, fig.height=4}
PlotBoxplotsProp(
  obs %>% filter(timepoint == "T0") %>% droplevels,
  ann.col = "cellstate",
  filterCol = "cellstate",
  filterVal = c("PD1Hi Tfh"),
  relative.to = "celltype",
  minDenomFreq = 10,
  exportDF = T
) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = diagSub, y = prop)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = NA) +

             shape = 21, alpha = 0.75, position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.75, seed = thisseed)) +
  facet_wrap(~cellstate, scales = "free_y", ncol=10) +
  scale_y_break(c(0.22, 0.4), scale = 0.5) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 7)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  scale_color_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = diagSub.comp, label = "p.format", vjust = 1.2, size = 4.5, label.y = c(0.43, 0.48, 0.53, 0.58)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent, breaks = seq(0,1,0.1)) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(
    x = NULL, 
    y = "Percentage of T/NK/ILCs", 
  ) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
```
